77: After the events of the Lost Logia case, Nanoha waits patiently for the day she can reunite with her newfound friend, Fate. Although being an exceptionally powerful mage, Nanoha spends her days normally with her friends on Earth. But peace is once again suddenly shattered, as Nanoha is without warning attacked by a powerful mage. A group of violent mages have been attacking anything with magic power for their own goals. Nanoha and Fate, along with their friends Yuuno, Arf, Chrono and the Space/Time Administration Bureau must once more band together to stop these renegade mages from hurting anyone or anything else. Takes place after the first season of Lyrical Nanoha.

Dopo gli eventi del caso Lost Logia, Nanoha aspetta pazientemente il giorno in cui potrà ricongiungersi con il suo nuovo amico, Fate. Pur essendo un mago eccezionalmente potente, Nanoha trascorre le sue giornate normalmente con i suoi amici sulla Terra. Ma la pace è di nuovo improvvisamente fracassata, come Nanoha è senza preavviso attaccato da un potente mago. Un gruppo di maghi violenti ha attaccato qualsiasi cosa con potere magico per i propri obiettivi. Nanoha e Fate, insieme ai loro amici Yuuno, Arf, Chrono e lo Space/Time Administration Bureau devono ancora una volta unirsi per impedire a questi maghi rinnegati di ferire chiunque o qualsiasi altra cosa. Si svolge dopo la prima stagione di Nanoha Lirica.
141: Aoba used to spend all her time building model robots. But after a strange enemy emerges from beneath the planet’s surface, she joins an elite unit that uses giant robots to save the world! Aoba’s new life is dangerous, and the action can only intensify when a greater threat appears from the shadows.
205: Let's break it down. Mugen's a reckless sword-slinger with a style that's more b-boy than Shaolin. He's got a nasty streak that makes people want to stick a knife in his throat. Then there's Jin, a deadbeat ronin who speaks softly but carries a big blade. He runs game old-school style, but he can make your blood spray with the quickness. When these roughnecks bring the ruckus, it ain't good for anybody, especially them. Enter Fuu, the ditzy waitress who springs her new friends from a deadly jam. All she wants in return is help solving a riddle from her past. She and the boys are tracking the scent, but there's 99 ways to die between them and the sunflower samurai.

Scriviamolo. Mugen e' un'incosciente spada-stingue con uno stile che e' piu' b-boy di Shaolin. Ha una brutta vena che fa venire voglia di infilargli un coltello in gola. Poi c'è Jin, un ronin fannullone che parla dolcemente ma porta una lama grande. Gestisce giochi alla vecchia maniera, ma puo' fare il tuo spray con la velocita'. Quando questi rompicoglioni portano il casino, non fa bene a nessuno, specialmente a loro. Entra Fuu, la cameriera idiota che libera i suoi nuovi amici da una marmellata mortale. Tutto quello che vuole in cambio e' aiutare a risolvere un indovinello del suo passato. Lei e i ragazzi stanno seguendo il profumo, ma ci sono 99 modi per morire tra loro e il samurai di girasole.
269:
Ichigo Kurosaki is a rather normal high school student apart from the fact he has the ability to see ghosts. This ability never impacted his life in a major way until the day he encounters the Shinigami Kuchiki Rukia, who saves him and his family's lives from a Hollow, a corrupt spirit that devours human souls.

Wounded during the fight against the Hollow, Rukia chooses the only option available to defeat the monster and passes her Shinigami powers to Ichigo. Now forced to act as a substitute until Rukia recovers, Ichigo hunts down the Hollows that plague his town.

Ichigo Kurosaki è uno studente di scuola superiore piuttosto normale a parte il fatto che ha la capacità di vedere i fantasmi. Questa abilità non ha mai influenzato la sua vita in modo importante fino al giorno in cui incontra lo Shinigami Kuchiki Rukia, che salva lui e la sua famiglia da un Vuoto, uno spirito corrotto che divora le anime umane.

Ferito durante la lotta contro il Vuoto, Rukia sceglie l'unica opzione disponibile per sconfiggere il mostro e passa i suoi poteri Shinigami a Ichigo. Ora costretto ad agire come sostituto fino a quando Rukia non si riprende, Ichigo caccia i Vuoti che affliggono la sua città.
333: Natsumi Mizuki is a 4th grader whose parents have gone to London. Her Aunt Izumi comes to live with her. Izumi is an aspiring manga writer who is trying to get her first big break, so she doesn't have time for a baby that appears out of thin air on Natsumi's first night alone. The baby's name is Mirai and her mother is *Natsumi*, but 15 years older. Somehow, Mirai had traveled back in time. Now the young Natsumi has to raise Mirai while trying to keep her 4th grade life from falling apart and keep Mirai-chan secret from everyone. She has the dubious help of Izumi and some baby-care gadgets from the future.
397: Due to a lack of ambassadors for the recently-conquered worlds the rapidly advancing fleet of the Bebaus brothers leave behind, Lafiel is appointed Territorial Ambassador of the planet Lobnas II. Upon arriving to the planet Jinto and Lafiel discover that the planet was used by the United Mankind as a prison planet and now has a million prisoners on the only inhabited island. The prisoners are parted in three blocks. The western where women are housed, the eastern belongs to the men and the central is mixed under the restriction that all prisoners living there are sterilized. The women in the western sector want to emigrate from the planet of fear for the men and when they do the men in the east rebel, overthrowing the guards and capturing Jinto to try to stop the emigration of the women. At the same time an enemy fleet heads toward the system forcing Lafiel to abandon Jinto.
461: The crew comes upon Crown Island where the animals can talk and they makes Chopper their new king. But there are human hunters there also looking for the legendary horns that will give the person who consumes it immense power. Luffy and friends must stop them from destroying this animal kingdom.

L'equipaggio arriva sull'isola della Corona dove gli animali possono parlare e fanno di Chopper il loro nuovo re. Ma ci sono cacciatori umani che cercano anche le corna leggendarie che daranno alla persona che lo consuma un immenso potere. Luffy e gli amici devono impedire loro di distruggere questo regno animale.
525: The year is 972 A.D. in Kyoto, the capital of ancient Japan. Kyoto is becoming a corrupt and run-down city; selfish samurai and onmyoji, who care only about gaining political power are everywhere. To make matters worse the city is suffering from famine and widespread disease. Unable to ignore the condition of the city any longer, the Imperial Court decides to send Minamoto no Raiko, a famous samurai well-known for his archery skills, to recover a legendary gem said to hold mysterious power to save the world. However Raiko also falls ill to disease. Instead his youngest sister, Hikaru, decides secretely to make the journey in his place. Hikaru meets many people, and has many adventures while on her trip for the legendary gem.
589:
Born in the bitter cold of the Ouu Mountains as the son of Riki, the mightiest bear-hunting dog, is the magnificent tiger-striped puppy, Gin!

To defeat the murderous Akakabuto—who seeks to build a stronghold deep in the mountains of Ou after defeating his grandfather and father—Gin joins the Ouu Army, his youthful blood boiling with determination!! With only three months left until the final showdown with Akakabuto, his eyes are set on finding true “men” who will fight alongside his comrades to the bitter end against Akakabuto, as he races across the entire land of Japan!!

Nato nel freddo amaro dei Monti Ouu come il figlio di Riki, il cane più potente cacciatore di orso, è il magnifico cucciolo striato di tigre, Gin!

Per sconfiggere l'assassino Akakabuto che cerca di costruire una roccaforte nelle montagne di Ou dopo aver sconfitto suo nonno e suo padre, Gin si unisce all'esercito di Ouu, il suo sangue giovanile che bolle con determinazione!! Mancano solo tre mesi alla resa dei conti finale con Akakabuto, i suoi occhi sono puntati a trovare veri uomini che combatteranno insieme ai suoi compagni fino alla fine amara contro Akakabuto, mentre corre attraverso l'intera terra del Giappone!!
653: Their mission is to locate and retrieve the mysterious Lost Technology, even though these girls have never been known to stick to their mission. Milfeulle, Forte, Ranpha, Mint, and Vanilla are back for another round of hilarity. The Galaxy Angels have sworn to protect the galaxy one planet at a time. Now with some competition with the newly-formed Twin Star Brigade, they continue to find themselves in the center of chaos... though usually they're the ones at fault for its cause.
781: Kaitou Kid announces to the police that he intends to steal the Russian Imperial Easter Egg, which is currently being held in Osaka. As Conan pursues his rival, he discovers that there's more to this case then simply stopping a robbery.

Kaitou Kid annuncia alla polizia che intende rubare l'uovo imperiale russo di Pasqua, attualmente detenuto a Osaka. Mentre Conan insegue il suo rivale, scopre che c'è di più in questo caso poi semplicemente fermare una rapina.
845: In a dystopian future, two friends dream of freedom... and gain more than they bargain for! Hothead Zed is on the run from the authorities, while his brainy pal Noah struggles with his own battered body. Both find a magical world that seems to offer escape and power undreamed of. Join Zed and his powerful, rebellious spirit Amir Gaul on their search for the ultimate power. It's a force that can save the world - or destroy life as we know it. This is the world of KIBA! Where you must harness the power within and fight with all you got!

In un futuro distopico, due amici sognano la liberta'... e guadagnano piu' di quello che vogliono! Hothead Zed è in fuga dalle autorità, mentre il suo amico intelligente Noah lotta con il suo corpo maltrattato. Entrambi trovano un mondo magico che sembra offrire la fuga e il potere senza sosta. Unisciti a Zed e al suo potente spirito ribelle Amir Gallia nella loro ricerca del potere ultimo. È una forza che può salvare il mondo - o distruggere la vita come la conosciamo. Questo è il mondo di KIBA! Dove si deve sfruttare il potere dentro e combattere con tutto quello che hai!
909: In the 21st century mankind was on the brink of destruction. Through genetic engineering however they eradicated such feelings as love and the desire for power. Since women are naturally less agressive than men, women to man ratio was set to 9:1. Now people are engineered to have skills that others view as being necessary. There is a giant ring that now orbits the earth, that sits there and relays information back to an alien race that sent it. Now a team of five women will try to eradicate the alien threat.
1037:
The seal which was imprisoning the fallen angels, Kirin no Yuda and Houou no Ruka, is broken and the two decide to get revenge on the God who had cast them to Hell by getting rid of the Heavens that had once been their home. Soon the guardian angels on Earth begin disappearing, and no one in Heaven can explain the happenings. But there is a sense of a vengeful animal spirit at work, and so the four Saint Beasts are called upon to investigate.

The 4 Gods of Beasts attempt to rescue the guardian angels, as well as to find out what this evil animal spirit is...
1101: A girl, Mayuka, appears one day claiming to be Tenchi's daughter, much to the shock of the Masaki household. Chaos ensues as Washu attempts to discover Mayuka's background, and the girls adjust to the new presence at their home. The result of her appearance reaches back into the past, and puts Tenchi in danger. Tenchi and Ryoko must travel into the realm of a demon called Yuzuha in order to try and set things right, but their task is not an easy one.
1165: The year is around the 1920's and the darkness of the demons have arrived. Now, only the people with large amounts of spirit energy can save the Earth. The Flower Division is now going to be sent out destroy the demons for they're our only hope for survival with their new steam-powered machines and unique fighting techniques.
1293: It all begins when aliens invade and threaten to conquer the Earth! However, one member of the human race is chosen at random to duel the aliens and save the planet: Ataru Moroboshi, a lecherous slacker from Tomobiki High School who begrudgingly participates. All he has to do? Play a game of tag and catch Lum — the beautiful alien princess in a tiger-stripe bikini — by the horns. Unfortunately for Ataru, it’s not so simple, since Lum can fly and deliver electric shocks! Perseverance pays off, but once he catches her, Ataru experiences another shock: He’s now Lum’s betrothed “darling” and she isn’t going back to her home planet anytime soon!

Tutto inizia quando gli alieni invadono e minacciano di conquistare la Terra! Tuttavia, un membro della razza umana è scelto a caso per duellare gli alieni e salvare il pianeta: Ataru Moroboshi, un lecherous slacker della scuola superiore di Tomobiki che begrudgingly partecipa. Tutto quello che deve fare? Gioca un gioco di tag e catturare Lum la bella principessa alieno in un bikini tigre-stripe di clacson. Purtroppo per Ataru, non è così semplice, dal momento che Lum può volare e fornire scosse elettriche! La perseveranza ripaga, ma una volta che la cattura, Ataru sperimenta un altro shock: Lum è ora fidanzata con Lum, e lei non è tornata al suo pianeta natale presto!
1357: In a post-apocalyptic Earth, the water has become entirely toxic, except for some kept safe in a reservoir. A fortified zone has been created by a man named Sanga, he calls it The Lastland. A group of villagers have discovered safe water, and Sanga wants it. He and his band of killers go to kill everyone and steal it. As they do a mysterious man apperes out of nowhere, instantly killing some of Sanga's men. His name is Kenshiro, and he can beat any man with his martial art, Hokuto Shin Ken. Sanga will do anything for the water, and Kenshiro will do anything to try and stop him.
1421: A draft of Ernest Hemingway's final novel might hold the secret to an immense hidden treasure, and master thief Lupin the Third is on the hunt! He’ll have the help of his partners and the beautiful bartender Maria, but he'll have to contend with a local civil war, the mercenary Crazy Mash, and his super-wealthy boss Marces to get it.
1485: Two months ago, Takuya Enoki's mother passed away in an accident leaving him to take care of his baby brother, Minoru, while their father works the long hours of a Japanese "salaryman". Takuya must sacrifice playtime and childhood to take care of his brother and do the responsibilities an adult would have: cooking, sewing, and scolding while trying to find it in his heart to love the brother who is causing him so much grief.
1549:
AD 1999, the Earth was in a critical situation; a planet Lar Metal was approaching to the Earth. Meanwhile, Yukino Yayoi was heard about Lar Metal from Dr. Amamori of Tokyo Observatory. She was a junior high school teacher, but she also worked for Dr. Amamori who appreciated her astronomical knowledge. Actually Yukino Yayoi was Queen Millennia who had come from Lar Metal 1000 years before, and she had been watching human beings since then.

Soon, numerous meteors fell on the Earth, and people were in panic. In this catastrophe, Hajime, who was a student of Yayoi, came to help Yayoi. Yayoi invited him into a big cave under the ground.
1613: Preparing a party for her anniversary with the King, when he failed to show up Chocola decided to run away from the castle.
1677: Pirates have kidnapped Zero in an attempt to finally defeat the notorious Captain Harlock. Harlock is bound by a promise to his friend Toshiro to protect his lab on a strange mushroom planet. Fates collide as Zero, Harlock, Sylviana and the pirate Hunter all pursue their own agendas during one decisive battle.
1741: Special episodes included in DVD volumes 1 through 4.
1805: In the 1920's, Inaho resurrects a vampire named Mosquiton with her blood. He awakens and becomes her slave. Now, Inaho is after the O-Part, which will grant her immortality. However, a bunch of supernatural monsters are out to stop them from achieving their goal.
1933:
A promotional ova that came with the PS2 game, Growlanser IV Returns which is an add-on featuring a compilation of three short stories that is told in visual novel style.

Since it is a promotional ova, various main characters from Growlanser I, Growlanser II, and Growlanser III do appear in the ED. Actually, some of the fairies of these main characters do appear in Growlanser IV as that the entire Growlanser story is based on anti-war featuring time freeze, time traveling, and parallel worlds.
2061: Lufy, discovered floating lifeless in space, is brought on board a Solnoid cruiser and given another chance at life. Once the hardened warrior, she is shown events that shake her faith (one's own death seems to have a way of changing one's philosophy) and lessening her power as a fighter just as that power is most needed!
2125:
These are two recap specials that focus on Team Urameshi's matches in the Dark Tournament, with a few character songs playing in the background.

There are also two shorts at the end of each episode, both of which are about 1:20 long.

2253:
Koji Kabuto’s grandfather has discovered two resources which can save humanity: Photon Light Energy and the ultra-impregnable alloy Chogokin Z. However, Dr. Kabuto’s research is abruptly cut off when the evil Dr. Hell sends his trusted lieutenant, the bisected Baron Ashura, to assassinate him! Koji, now orphaned along with younger brother Shiro, swear revenge using Dr. Kabuto’s last and greatest invention: the super robot Mazinger Z!

Joined by Dr. Kabuto’s successor, Dr. Yumi, his daughter Sayaka, and her research robot Aphrodite A, Koji sets out to protect Japan from Dr. Hell’s menacing mecha monsters and ensure the peaceful work of the Photon Light Institute. Can Koji and Sayaka, along with local bully boy Boss, prevent this most dangerous of villains from running amok and conquering the world?

Il nonno di Koji Kabuto ha scoperto due risorse che possono salvare l'umanità: Photon Light Energy e la lega ultra-imprendibile Chogokin Z. Tuttavia, la ricerca del dottor Kabuto è bruscamente interrotta quando il malvagio Dottor Inferno manda il suo fidato tenente, il barone Ashura bisettato, ad assassinarlo! Koji, ora orfano insieme al fratello minore Shiro, giura vendetta usando il Dr. Kabuto® ultima e più grande invenzione: il super robot Mazinger Z!

Il Dr. Yumi, sua figlia Sayaka, e il suo robot di ricerca Aphrodite A, Koji, si propone di proteggere il Giappone dai mostri mecha minacciosi del Dr. Hell, e di assicurare il lavoro pacifico del Photon Light Institute. Koji e Sayaka, insieme al bullo locale Boss, possono evitare che questo più pericoloso dei cattivi scappino e vincano il mondo?
2317: Yoshida Chizuru is the sexiest co-ed in her class. Secretly, she's been appearing in TV commercials - despite the fact that students are forbidden from working. But one of her professors has uncovered her secret and hopes to use this information to his advantage. Yoshida's got plans of her own, and has no intention of giving up her acting career...
2573: Lucy's family moves from England to Australia planning to run a big farm. Starting a new life proves to be full of frustrations. Their agonizing days of despair continue until they finally obtain their farmland. However, Lucy and her sisters enjoy a range of new experiences such as discovering exotic animals and meeting with aborigines and other new people.
2765:
Like the prior film, the movie features the "Peach Boy" character of Japanese folklore. The film is about the surprise maneuver on Sulawesi island, depicting parachute troops' actions. The whole movie also depicts how Japan "liberates Asia", as proclaimed by the Government at the time.

There are some musical scenes. Of note is The Song of AIUEO (アイウエオの歌, AIUEO no Uta), a scene where Japanese soldiers teach local animals how to speak.
2829: Remy, a cheerful and tender-hearted girl, lives with her mother in a French country town. One day her father returns to the town after a long period working away from home in a city. Her father tells Remy that she isn't their real daughter, and Remy is almost sold to an evil slave trader. It is Vitalis, a strolling entertainer, who helps Remy. Vitalis discovers her talent for singing and decides to take her in with his troupe.
3021:
Hirono Kenta is your average geeky Junior High School student. His childhood obsession has always been Tokusatsu and Anime. In fact, he fancies himself as a "Hero of Justice" and often is seen running around in a makeshift costume of his own design called "Wing Man." Most of his fellow classmates thinks he`s just a crazy "otaku", but his childhood friend Ogawa Miku thinks he`s a noble spirit.

One day as Hirono is walking to school, a beautiful and voluptuous girl, literally drops out of the sky and into his life.

Hirono, bewildered by the event, none-the-less takes the girl to his home to recuperate (this is his duty as a "Hero of Justice"). He also keeps the "Dream Note" so that he can transpose his favorite "Wing Man" costume designs into it.

Later, Hirono is confronted by the girl who reveals herself to be Yume Aoi, Princess of the Dreamscape called Botoreem. Her domain has been conquered by the power mad despot, Rimeru and his armies of monstrous "Seed Men". She barely escaped her domain with the power artifact known as the "Dream Note".

The "Dream Note" enables its possessor to create anything they desire by merely drawing or writing information within its pages. Rimeru seeks to steal it to become Master of the Universe.

She demands that Hirono give her back the book, but Hirono had already begun drawing into the book (mystically linking himself to it).

Hirono soon discovers that his designs and notes on Wing Man become reality and he in turn becomes his own creation.

Using these powers and abilities, he and Aoi begin their strange and amazing adventure. Along the way, Hirono inadvertently involves all of his friends, especially Miku in his quest to help Aoi free her people and save her father.

Rimeru sends his various minions to Earth's dimension to retrieve the book. One his henchmen is the noble yet devious Kitakura who goes as far as infiltrating Hirono's Junior High School masquerading as a teacher.
3085: Set in a near future, a time where robots are common workers for their owners. Takaya Murase has just purchased a maid robot from a robotic doll distriubutor, MaidWorks. Ready to live a normal cleaning, cooking, and serving life to her owner, Yui is purchased, by Takaya but he has other plans for her...like dressing her up in dress-costumes of his fantasies and more.
3213:
Horiguchi Genki was 5 years old boy. His mother died when he was born, and he was raised only by his father. His father, Shark Horiguchi, was a professional boxer, but he was ruined and become an itinerant boxer. However, Genki believed his father was strong and he would become a champion, and he had a dream to become a strong boxer as his father.

After his father’s death, he was adopted by his grandparents. Although they opposed Genki boxing, Genki made up his mind to become a boxer, and he continued training secretly. Meeting with various people, for example, Teacher Ashikiwa who resembles his mother, Mishima who is a high school boxing champion, he made his way to be a boxer.
3469: A series of chibi-style shorts included with the Maria-sama ga Miteru: Haru DVD releases.
3533:
Based on a Playstation 2 game by the same title, Varanoir's story takes place in a Magic University called.. well Varanoir. Students in this university are trained here for war preparation against the devil master.

The main characters of the story is Myu, a granddaughter of Jii. Jii was a great swordsman in the past and he taught various sword fighting skills to Myu, although he's working as a chimney cleaner right now in Varanoir. Myu then decides to go to Varanoir for training to become a fighter. In Varanoir, Myu meets Ryuto, a talented student. However, Ryuto always sees Myu as her rival.

[From Animenfo.com]
3597: Akihiro is a teenaged boy with fantasies. He's about to have date with his girlfriend Miyuki when he finds a strange carpet on his way home. Malon, a pretty and over-energetic girl named Malon appears from the carpet. She tells Akihiro about the world of Phantasia and wants to live with Akihiro. But even if Akihiro loves pretty girls, he becomes angry with Malon's magical powers and drives her away. The maniac wizard, Roll, who wants to kill Malon, doesn't help at all.
3661: Joker is a genetically engineered shape-and-gender-shifter, who created as part of a Special Police Task Force and fights crime of all kinds, but they also fit in a little romance around the edges.
4173: Side stories released exclusively on DVD.
4621: This is a story of a 13 year old girl whose only dream is to participate in the Olympic Games: Her Struggles, her victories, her failures and her willpower fascinate all who help her to become a outstanding athlete.
4685: An 11-year-old boy, Takasumi Takane, will be given a new bicycle if his exam results are in the top 100, but his results put him in 112th place. He tells his mother a lie that he placed 92nd, and he tears the answer sheets apart. On his way home from cram school, he accidently breaks the old bicycle that he is supposed to hand down to his little sister, Tamaki. This angers Tamaki. Furthermore, Tamaki accuses him of telling a lie, and he begins to think of her as a nuisance. One night, when he goes to a shrine to look for his missing dog, Chris, he encounters a young man named Yoyogi. Somehow, Yoyogi has the answer sheet marked as “92nd." Yoyogi proposes a trade, but threatens to return the answer sheet to its original owner unless he is given something Takane doesn't need. Takane offers him his sister, Tamaki. At that very moment, Tamaki arrives, searching for Takane and Chris. Yoyogi turns Tamaki into a shining object and swallows her. Takane decides that he was wrong and wants to save her. Yoyogi agrees to restore Tamaki to her original form if Takane wins a race against him, with his broken bicycle. Can Takane win the race rescue Tamaki?
4941:
Tezuka Osamu who going to a 21 Century new year's party with all the charters he made. One thing leads to another and he ends up missing! It's up to his most popular charters to find out what happened to him and get him back safely before the rest of the guest show up

(Souce: Kuro Hazama (a Black Jack shrine))
5005:
The story revolves around the Tama River area, based mostly in Kawasaki City Kanagawa where battles are fought between the evil organisation Florsheim and the ally of justice Sunred. The twist is that Sunred (referred to most characters familiar with him as Red-san) is a rough-talking, violent and rude hero while the villains of Florsheim (led by General Vamp) are for the most part polite, conscientious and easy-going.

Despite this, both sides still stay true to their roles, with Florsheim dedicated to destroying Sunred and taking over the world while Sun Red battles against them. Other evil organisations and heroes are also mentioned from time to time.

Each episode is divided into various shorts of varying length. Most of the humour comes from the interactions of the characters, especially the main trio of Sunred, his girlfriend Kayoko and General Vamp. Kayoko and Vamp, for example, get along very well and she occasionally consults him about housework or cooking. In contrast, she and Sunred often argue like a long married couple.
5133:
To escape the explosion of their ship caused by a terrorist attack, the parents of a young baby put him inside an escape pod and send him out before dying. The pod ends up on a planet inhabited by beings able to transform themselves into animals by using a special ring. The young baby is rescued by the royal family, and grows up to become the prince.

When the planet is attacked by pirates, he will be brought by force to Earth and discover everything about his own origins, and forgotten brother.
5197: Tokio and his father Amon go to the soccer country of Elevenia where they see a parade of the strongest soccer team of that country, the Winners. Amon challenges the team captain Leon to a soccer battle and, when Amon loses, Leon turns him into a miniature dragon. Tokio sees the fight and decides to challenge against Leon so that Amon can become human again.
5581: All the nations of Earth are crumbling before the might of Darius, ruler of the Gabia Empire. Meanwhile, childhood friends Ben and Ricky are sailing on the oceans is search of the lost city of Atlantis. When their ship is sunk they are saved by Captain Nemo in his submarine Nautilus.
6093: At age 16, a tomboy princess, Princess Anmitsu, has no love interest in her life and worries her parents. Despite their concern, Anmitsu runs away from the castle to venture into the commoners' life. During her daring adventure, she befriends a group of children who make a living by pick-pocketing. At the same time, she finally meets her prince charming Senbei, the leader of the group. However, she soon finds herself in an awkward position when she learns of the children's new plot: they are planning to steal the treasures from her own castle. Will she be able to put a stop to it without revealing her true identity?
6413:
Go! Go! Ackman is the story about a 200 year old demon child named Ackman who harvests souls for the Dark Devil Lord.

Note: First released to public at 1994 V-Jump Festa, later it became a special video feature to be requested by V-Jump purchasers.
6733: A remake of episodes 12-13 of the TV version.
6797: Raoul, an alligator, has a bad tooth, and also needs a hair cut. Is he going to a barber, or a dentist, or neither of them? Madillo, an armadillo, wonders if he should bring an umbrella, or not. So, what is your choice? In the story of this animated film, a series of events which need judgments, spontaneity and decisiveness of the "Junior Directors" continue to occur.
6861:
In this story, the kids are constantly forced to bury themselves into their endless homework by those giant monsters behind them. The children's brains are filled with water that can be heated by tension. If a kid is overstressed, the water in their brain would boil and produce steam, which becomes the food of the greedy monsters and the energy of the whole city. Water Brain, the head is in the water.

Graduation design work of the Ani7ime team of the Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts.
6989: Dr. Tatsunoko of Tatsunoko Research Center goes undersea accompanied by his daughter Asari to inquire into some mysterious radiation and discovers there a giant shell and it is known that the radiation comes from a globe laid inside the shell. 7117: An animation documentary describing the tragic consequences of the A-bomb explosion in Hiroshima on August 6th, 1945. 9613:

10893:

E' Kyoto, eppure non lo e'.

Un microcosmo di particolari origini, "Mirror Kyoto."

11021:
Since 1973, an invasion of aliens known as BETA upon Earth is driving human civilization into nearly collapse. Facing an enormous mass of enemy force, mankind has developed large humanoid arms called as Tactical Surface Fighters and deployed them to its defense lines through out the world. However, all those efforts could slow down defeats but could not stop BETA, and mankind is forced to abandon major area of the Eurasian Continent. For 30 years, mankind is bogged down in an endless war against BETA without any hopes of victory.

In 2001, the Imperial Japan faces difficulties in the development of a next-generation main Tactical Surface Fighters (TSF) as it defends the front lines of the Far East. The UN has proposed a joint development program between the Imperial Japan and the United States as a part of its international mutual development project of TSF, the Prominence Project.

Yui Takamura, a surface pilot of the Imperial Royal Guards of Japan, is given responsibility for the project and sets off to Alaska. Meanwhile, Yuya Bridges, also a surface pilot of the US Army, was heading to the same destination.

Yet they never knew that their encounter would change their destiny drastically.

This story with exciting human dramas and robot actions takes place in the development of a new Tactical Surface Fighters, the most important and effective weapons against BETA, at a crisis of human extinction.

Dal 1973, un'invasione di alieni conosciuti come BETA sulla Terra sta spingendo la civiltà umana in quasi collasso. Di fronte ad un'enorme massa di forze nemiche, l'umanità ha sviluppato grandi armi umanoidi chiamate come combattenti tattici di superficie e li ha dispiegati nelle sue linee di difesa attraverso il mondo. Tuttavia, tutti questi sforzi potrebbero rallentare le sconfitte, ma non potrebbero fermare BETA, e l'umanità è costretta ad abbandonare la grande area del Continente Eurasiatico. Per 30 anni, l'umanità è impantanata in una guerra infinita contro BETA senza alcuna speranza di vittoria.

Nel 2001, l'Imperial Japan si trova di fronte a difficoltà nello sviluppo di un principale combattente tattico di nuova generazione (TSF) in quanto difende le prime linee dell'Estremo Oriente. L'ONU ha proposto un programma di sviluppo congiunto tra l'Imperial Japan e gli Stati Uniti come parte del suo progetto internazionale di sviluppo reciproco di TSF, il Progetto di Prominenza.

Yui Takamura, pilota di superficie delle Guardie Reali Imperiali del Giappone, è responsabile del progetto e parte per l'Alaska. Nel frattempo, Yuya Bridges, anche pilota di superficie dell'esercito statunitense, si dirigeva verso la stessa destinazione.

Eppure non hanno mai saputo che il loro incontro avrebbe cambiato drasticamente il loro destino.

Questa storia con emozionanti drammi umani e azioni robotiche si svolge nello sviluppo di un nuovo Tactical Surface Fighters, le armi più importanti ed efficaci contro BETA, in una crisi di estinzione umana.

Madoka Kaname ha cambiato il mondo. In questo nuovo mondo, cosa vedono le ragazze magiche un mondo di speranza... o disperazione?
12237: Koi-Ken Love Research club member Kaede Wakamiya comments that being an idol must be extremely easy—a comment that irritates idol Nagisa Toyama. 12685: In the all-new story, Lelouch makes the ultimate use of his Geass power for his little sister Nunnally, who loves Alice in Wonderland.

La storia è ambientata dopo la fine della finale del torneo Holy Road della prima Inazuma Eleven GO anime, e Tenma torna alla Raimon Junior High School. Tuttavia, questo non è il Raimon che Tenma ricorda, e i membri della squadra di Raimon non giocano più a calcio.

14093: Satoshi, Iris & Dent continue their travels through the Isshu region. Satoshi, Iris & Dent continuano i loro viaggi attraverso la regione di Isshu. Il Team Rocket, nel frattempo, avvia il loro piano finale per la regione di Isshu - qual è il loro scopo nel desiderio per il leggendario Pokémon Meloetta?
14349:
For young witches everywhere, the world-renowned witch Shiny Chariot reigns as the most revered and celebrated role model. But as the girls age, so do their opinions of her—now just the mention of Chariot would get a witch labeled a child. However, undeterred in her blind admiration for Chariot, ordinary girl Atsuko Kagari enrolls into Luna Nova Magical Academy, hoping to someday become just as mesmerizing as her idol.

However, the witch academy isn't all the fun and games Atsuko thought it would be: boring lectures, strict teachers, and students who mock Chariot plague the campus. Coupled with her own ineptness in magic, she's seen as little more than a rebel student. But when a chance finally presents itself to prove herself to her peers and teachers, she takes it, and now it's up to her to stop a rampaging dragon before it flattens the entire academy.

Little Witch Academia is one of the four anime works that each received 38 million yen (about US$480,000) from the "2012 Young Animator Training Project." Just like in 2010 and 2011, the animation labor group received 214.5 million yen (US$2.65 million) from the Japanese government's Agency for Cultural Affairs, and it distributed most of those funds to studios who train young animators on-the-job.

Positive response to the movie led Studio Trigger to run a Kickstarter funding a sequel, which surpassed its funding goal.

Per le giovani streghe di tutto il mondo, la strega di fama mondiale Shiny Chariot regna come il modello di ruolo più venerato e celebrato. Ma mentre le ragazze invecchiano, così le loro opinioni del suo ora solo la menzione di Chariot avrebbe ottenuto una strega etichettata un bambino. Tuttavia, indistruttibile nella sua cieca ammirazione per Chariot, la ragazza ordinaria Atsuko Kagari si iscrive all'Accademia Magica di Luna Nova, sperando di diventare un giorno altrettanto affascinante come il suo idolo.

Tuttavia, l'accademia delle streghe non è tutto il divertimento e i giochi che Atsuko ha pensato che sarebbe stato: lezioni noiose, insegnanti rigorosi, e gli studenti che deridono Chariot affliggono il campus. Abbinata alla sua inettitudine nella magia, e' vista poco piu' di una studentessa ribelle. Ma quando finalmente si presenta una possibilità di dimostrare se stessa ai suoi coetanei e insegnanti, lei la prende, e ora sta a lei fermare un drago infuriato prima che appiattisca l'intera accademia.

Little Witch Academia è una delle quattro opere animate che hanno ricevuto 38 milioni di yen (circa 480.000 dollari) dal "2012 Young Animator Training Project." Proprio come nel 2010 e 2011, il gruppo di lavoro di animazione ha ricevuto 214,5 milioni di yen (2,65 milioni di dollari) dall'Agenzia per gli Affari Culturali del governo giapponese, e ha distribuito la maggior parte di quei fondi agli studi che addestrano giovani animatori sul posto di lavoro.

La risposta positiva al film ha portato Studio Trigger a eseguire un finanziamento Kickstarter un sequel, che ha superato il suo obiettivo di finanziamento.
14669: Ichirou Satou once lived a life of adolescent delusion as the great “Maryuin Koga.” Bullied by his peers and shunned by his classmates, Ichirou transferred schools in an effort star anew. Ichirou Satou una volta ha vissuto una vita di delirio adolescenziale come il grande Koga di Maryuin. Prepotente dai suoi coetanei e fuggito dai suoi compagni di classe, Ichirou trasferì nuovamente le scuole in una star dello sforzo. Anche se Ichirou cerca di evitare questa ragazza, si ritrova presto a difenderla mentre tenta di riportarla nel mondo reale.
14989: In 21st century Japan, cars with artificial intelligence for increased safety, known as "A.I. cars," have revolutionized the car industry. 15117: It is summer break and Keima intends to spend all his time on video games. An old acquaintance, the timid girl Tenri, comes back into the neighborhood - and apparently has a lost soul inside her. It is up to Keima and Elysia to unravel the secrets of her heart.

15437: An unaired OVA episode of Kore wa Zombie Desu ka? of the Dead. It is the 11th episode and was bundled with the sixth volume of the manga.

16397: Kazuya, a mild-mannered high school sophomore coming to the end of a very average summer break, receives a digital single lens reflex camera as a gift. Kazuya, una mite educata del secondo anno della scuola superiore che arriva alla fine di una pausa estiva molto media, riceve una fotocamera reflex digitale a singolo obiettivo come regalo. Il suo fascino nerd con il suo design si trasforma presto in domanda quando si rende conto che questo piccolo gadget potrebbe davvero dare la sua vita sociale un colpo nel braccio!
17165: Princess Aurora, the only survivor of her planet destroyed by evil mutants, is resolved to put an end to the mutant menace in the galaxy along with three enhanced human cyborgs Jesse Dart, Porkos and Aramus, she travels space in the Cosmos Queen to the Dekkos System to fight the final battle.

Quando Hotaru si trasferisce da Tokyo a una piccola città nelle campagne rurali, si trova in una situazione di grave shock culturale: il luogo più vicino che vende fumetti è a 20 minuti di distanza, il video store più vicino è dieci stazioni ferroviarie lungo la linea, e ci sono solo altre tre ragazze e un ragazzo in tutta la sua scuola! Un vagabondo smarrito cerca rifugio in un santuario dove trova molti oggetti posseduti.

Una giovane ragazza chiede ad un orso bianco di sconfiggere un orco vizioso che rapisce le prime ragazze nate di un piccolo villaggio.

In un futuro post-apocalittico, un gruppo di soldati viene inviato in una città fantasma per distruggere una sentinella automatizzata.

Haruto never agrees to let Yuzuki stay at his house and always rejects her. Another girl, Kanzaki Nanami, comes whom Haruto might be in love with. So... what will happen in this story?

Eba Yuzuki, una ragazza di Tokyo si trasferisce in campagna per frequentare le superiori. Vive con un tipo di nome Kirishima Haruto il cui padre è apprendista del padre di Eba. Haruto non accetta mai di lasciare che Yuzuki rimanga a casa sua e la respinga sempre. Un'altra ragazza, Kanzaki Nanami, viene con cui Haruto potrebbe essere innamorato. Allora... cosa succedera' in questa storia?
17933: Based on the gag manga written and illustrated by Usuta Kyousuke that ran in Shuukan Shounen Jump from 2000 to 2010.

18637: Another Tetsuwan Atom Movie that was shown in the Tezuka Osamu World Cinema in Tokyo until it was closed in 2011.
18893: In the story, a Fleet of Fog loaded with super weapons suddenly appear all over the world. Without the ability to withstand this fleet, humanity was defeated and could no longer travel the seas. 17 years after the devastating naval war, Chihaya Gunzou and his friends somehow commandeer a Fleet of Fog submarine and rename it I-401. Together with Iona, they take on the Fleet of Fog.

Nella storia, una Flotta di Nebbia caricata di super armi appare improvvisamente in tutto il mondo. Senza la capacità di resistere a questa flotta, l'umanità fu sconfitta e non poteva più viaggiare nei mari. 17 anni dopo la devastante guerra navale, Chihaya Gunzou e i suoi amici in qualche modo conquistano un sottomarino della flotta di nebbia e lo rinominano I-401. Insieme a Iona, si imbarcano sulla Flotta di Nebbia.
19021: Summary of the first season of the show, as seen from Rikka's perspective with new elements.
Sommario della prima stagione dello spettacolo, come visto dal punto di vista di Rikka con nuovi elementi.
19213: The story of Adam and Eve with jazzy music. Short experimental animation without words. Mirai Mizue's postgraduation film.
19469:

Adattamento anime del manga Saiki Kusuo no 'Nan' di Asou Shuichi, raccontando la storia di uno studente maschio della scuola superiore di nome Kasuo Saiki. Possiede poteri soprannaturali che causano sfortunati eventi nella sua vita quotidiana.

(Fonte: Anime News Network)

Nota: Questa breve serie è stata rilasciata esclusivamente attraverso l'app per dispositivi mobili Jump LIVE (Jump LIVE).
19533:
Based on the horror manga ''Mumako'' by Fujio (A) Fujiko.

Fujiko Fujio A no Mumako consists of three short stories. Each story features its own protagonist, who suffers from some kind of stress caused by societal pressure. The only shared character across the stories is the titular side character Mumako, who, by the end of each story, grants a twisted interpretation of a wish which physically transforms the main character.

The titles of each story are an allusion to the nature of the transformation. In order of appearance, the stories are titled Castle (城), Transformation (変身), and Slough (脱皮).

Note: This was originally a one time broadcast on the entertainment program "Gimia Bureiku" on TBS.
19597: An image video, setting watercolors from Yumiko Kawahara's 1983 manga to a series of 11 pop songs.
19917:

Combined live action (handled by Akio Jissoji) and animation (handled by Shigetsugu Yoshida).

Released as a TV special.
19981: Based on a manga by Fujiko (A) Fujio and Fujiko (F) Fujio.
20045: An extended version of the second season's first episode, which is under the same title.
Una versione estesa del primo episodio della seconda stagione, che è sotto lo stesso titolo.
20109:
Tokiwa was the apartment complex where a group of stellar artists lived in 1953.

Hiro Terada, Motoo Abiko and Hiroshi Fujimoto, Shotaro Ishinomori and Fujio Akatsuka shared the trials and tribulations of being struggling young artists and writers with no money and no luck with editors or girls, with a spirit of insane youthful enthusiasm that enabled them to survive the lean years and emerge as stars of the manga firmament.
20173:
Bonolon is touted as the warrior who comes from the forest of the great oaks. Despite his huge body size and outwardly orange appearance, Bonolon is only a child of 9 years old.

However, notwithstanding his tender age, Bonolon possess a strong sense of justice and strives to become a reliable man. The tears of those people who are depressed or troubled will flow through the roots of the great oaks and communicates their feelings to Bonolon. Bonolon will then appear from the great oaks and help the people solve their problems as well as grant their wishes.
20237: A short series based on volleyball at the Munich Olympics. The series features a mix of live action blended with animation.
20493: The 16th-century shogun Oda Nobunaga wakes up in a high school girl's body.
20557: Anime for the Japanese phone company, KDDI au, to promote their new lab "au Mirai Kenkyuujo (A.U.F.L)".
20621: Ordinary high school students Shougo Ryuujin, Tyrone, Antonio, and Luke are the White Bone warriors. With their special Bone Cards they defend Earth from the evil Dark Bone, who has come from the darkness to destroy our world. However, the true identity of the "enemy" is still uncertain.
20685: The 13th episode of the Buddy Complex anime ended on Sunday with a "To be continued" message, and the official Twitter account and website for the anime confirmed that the series will still continue.
La 13a puntata del Buddy Complex anime si è conclusa domenica con un messaggio "Da continuare," e l'account ufficiale Twitter e il sito web per l'anime hanno confermato che la serie continuerà.
20749: Based on the same name gourmet manga that focuses on the dining of cuisine. The protagonist Jirou Tamiyamaru is more obssessed with how to eat than most people, and the anime comically depicts how he agonizes over the differences with how others eat.
20813:
With dreams of becoming a pâtissiere, Sayuri Haruno has worked hard for her scholarship to Fleurir Confectionery Academy, an elite school designed to train world class pastry chefs. The staff consists of unrivalled pâtissiers, who work with absolute precision—the prince-like Mitsuki Aoi, famous for his work with chocolate; the friendly and extroverted Gilbert Hanafusa, an expert in confectionery hailing from France; and the stoic Yoshinosuke Suzumi, who has perfected the art of Japanese sweets.

Upon admission to the school, Sayuri is thrust into a world of advanced baking, surrounded by both supportive and charming staff and fascinating classmates. Sayuri's attention is captured by the dedicated Ryou Kouzuki, who seems to share the same determination to achieve his dream.

Sayuri is set on the path for greatness, and her newly cultivated culinary skill will help her handle any challenge the school throws her way.

Con il sogno di diventare patissiere, Sayuri Haruno ha lavorato sodo per la sua borsa di studio alla Fleurir Pasticceria Academy, una scuola d'elite progettata per formare pasticceri di prim'ordine. Lo staff è composto da impareggiabili patissier, che lavorano con assoluta precisione il principe-come Mitsuki Aoi, famosa per il suo lavoro con il cioccolato; l'amichevole ed estroverso Gilbert Hanaphusa, esperto in pasticceria proveniente dalla Francia; e lo stoico Yoshinosuke Suzumi, che ha perfezionato l'arte dei dolci giapponesi.

Al momento dell'ammissione alla scuola, Sayuri viene spinto in un mondo di cottura avanzata, circondato sia da personale di supporto e affascinante e affascinanti compagni di classe. L'attenzione di Sayuri è catturata dal devoto Ryou Kouzuki, che sembra condividere la stessa determinazione per realizzare il suo sogno.

Sayuri è sul sentiero della grandezza, e la sua abilità culinaria appena coltivata la aiuterà a gestire qualsiasi sfida la scuola getta la sua strada.
20877: Teenage boys are notoriously lazy, and the members of Binan High School's Earth Defense Club are no exception. Their definition of “earth defense” is bumming around all day at the local bathhouse. But when a pink wombat appears out of thin air and begs the boys to help him save the planet, even the idlest high schoolers jump to action. Watch the magical boys transform and save the earth with the power of LOVE!

Gli adolescenti sono notoriamente pigri, e i membri del Club della Difesa della Terra del Liceo Binan non fanno eccezione. La loro definizione di difesa di terra è ronzante intorno tutto il giorno al bagno locale. Ma quando un ginecologo rosa appare dal nulla e prega i ragazzi di aiutarlo a salvare il pianeta, anche i più oziosi studenti saltano all'azione. Guardate i ragazzi magici trasformarsi e salvare la terra con il potere dell'AMORE!
20941: The story of the OVA series tells the continuation of the 13-episode TV anime in 2012, setting in the Japanese U-17 (under 17) High School Representatives Selection Camp.
21005:
The Grisaia no Meikyuu visual novel is a collection of sequels for all of the game's heroines, and also includes a prequel story for the hero and dozens of short stories. The first episode will be a 60 minute special that will air at the end of march.

Having attended Mihama Academy for about a year, Yuuji Kazami has seemingly found his place within the school, but he suddenly decides to pursue a promotion in CIRS. After consulting JB about his intentions, they both thoroughly examine Yuuji's documents and dissect the events of his upbringing to determine if the job is fit for him.

Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the two, the girls of Mihama uncover some torn documents in Yuuji's room. After restoring the papers, they discover the story that has formed—or perhaps broken—Yuuji into the man he is today. However, what was thought to be history has haunted him to the present, and the chains of the past begin to drag him back into the darkness...

La Grisaia no Meikyuu visual novel è una raccolta di sequel per tutte le eroine del gioco, e comprende anche una storia prequel per l'eroe e decine di racconti brevi. Il primo episodio sarà uno speciale di 60 minuti che andrà in onda alla fine di marzo.

Dopo aver frequentato Mihama Academy per circa un anno, Yuuji Kazami ha apparentemente trovato il suo posto all'interno della scuola, ma improvvisamente decide di perseguire una promozione nel CIRS. Dopo aver consultato JB sulle sue intenzioni, entrambi esaminano a fondo i documenti di Yuuji e dissezionano gli eventi della sua educazione per determinare se il lavoro è adatto per lui.

Nel frattempo, ignote ai due, le ragazze di Mihama scoprono alcuni documenti strappati nella stanza di Yuuji. Dopo aver ripristinato le carte, scoprono la storia che ha formato il killer o forse rotto il killer yuuji nell'uomo che è oggi. Tuttavia, quella che si pensava fosse la storia lo ha perseguitato fino al presente, e le catene del passato cominciano a trascinarlo di nuovo nell'oscurità...
21069:
Aki Miyagawa moved to Tokyo to pursue her dream to be a taiko drummer, but had a hard time balancing her strict training regimen with her part-time job. Now, after 15 years, she's returning to coach others for a taiko festival.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Project by J.C.Staff announced to be part of Anime Mirai 2015.

Aki Miyugawa si trasferì a Tokyo per inseguire il suo sogno di essere un batterista taiko, ma ebbe difficoltà a bilanciare il suo rigoroso regime di allenamento con il suo lavoro part-time. Ora, dopo 15 anni, torna ad allenare gli altri per un festival di taiko.

(Fonte: Anime News Network)

Il progetto di J.C.Staff ha annunciato di far parte di Anime Mirai 2015.
21197: Riding a bicycle may be better than walking, but when another girl zips past her on the way to class, Sakura Hane realizes that there’s an even better option: motorcycles!  Fortunately, Sakura’s all-girl school just happens to have a motorcycle club! It only has one member though: the mysterious Raimu Kawasaki, who’s never been seen without her face-obscuring helmet. But that changes immediately once Sakura and the girl who passed her, Onsa Amano, sign up and start recruiting! It won’t all be easy riding… Sakura still has to earn her license, and there are problems like the club’s official status having slipped, and the need to recruit a faculty sponsor.

Andare in bicicletta può essere meglio che camminare, ma quando un'altra ragazza le passa davanti sulla strada per la classe, Sakura Hane si rende conto che lì si trova un'opzione ancora migliore: motociclette! Per fortuna, Sakura ha una scuola per tutte le ragazze che si dà il caso di avere un club di motociclisti! Ha un solo membro però: il misterioso Raimu Kawasaki, che non viene mai visto senza il suo casco oscuro. Ma questo cambia immediatamente una volta Sakura e la ragazza che l'ha superata, Onsa Amano, si iscrivano e iniziavano a reclutare! E 'venuta tutta facile equitazione ... Sakura deve ancora guadagnare la sua licenza, e ci sono problemi come lo status ufficiale dei club che sono scivolati, e la necessità di reclutare uno sponsor di facoltà.
21261:
The Matsuno sextuplets (leader Osomatsu, wannabe tough guy Karamatsu, straight man Choromatsu, cynical Ichimatsu, cheerfully stupid Jyushimatsu and lovable spoiled Todomatsu) are now in their 20s, still living together in the same house as NEETs. Their neighbors still include such eccentric characters as fish market idol Totoko, loud bucktoothed troublemaker Iyami, tiny rival Chiba, wacky inventor Dekapan, and giant mouthed glutton Dayon.

Join the Matsuno siblings as they overcome mundane hurdles in their daily lives, such as finding employment, figure out who should pay the bar bill, and who should get the extra pastry!

I sextuppet Matsuno (leader Osomatsu, aspirante duro Karamatsu, uomo etero Choromatsu, cinico Ichimatsu, allegramente stupido Jyushimatsu e amabile viziato Todomatsu) sono ora a 20 anni, ancora vivendo insieme nella stessa casa come NEETs. I loro vicini includono ancora personaggi eccentrici come l'idolo del mercato del pesce Totoko, l'aggressore ad alto volume di bucktoothed Iyami, il piccolo rivale Chiba, l'inventore pazzo Dekapan, e il ghiottone gigante boccato Dayon.

Unisciti ai fratelli Matsuno quando superano gli ostacoli mondani nella loro vita quotidiana, come trovare lavoro, capire chi dovrebbe pagare il conto del bar, e chi dovrebbe ottenere la pasta extra!
21325: Short specials included with the Blu-ray Disc/DVD releases.
Specialità brevi incluse con le versioni Blu-ray Disc/DVD.
21389: Anime shorts that offer a secret candid look at the daily lives of Monster Musume. The shorts will update almost every weekday, but each short will be available for 24 hours only. The weekends will have a digest version summarizing the week's videos.

Pantaloncini anime che offrono uno sguardo segreto candido alla vita quotidiana di Monster Musume. I pantaloncini saranno aggiornati quasi ogni giorno della settimana, ma ogni breve sarà disponibile solo per 24 ore. I fine settimana avranno una versione digestiva che riassume i video della settimana.
21453: The 2nd PriPara film, unlike the first is shown in stereoscopic 3D.
21517: A Kiss Note is a powerful notebook that makes anyone who has their name written together will instantly fall in love if they kiss each other regardless of any circumstances. This magical and very familiar item belongs to an angel named Guri whose job as cupid is to create couples. However, she accidentally writes down Aino Seiji, a regular high school student, and unless he kisses someone, Guri will die. She convinces Seiji to go kiss his crush, Hiyama Akane, the school's popular girl who turns out has even stronger feelings for him, bordering on obsessive and psychotic. Eventually Akane and Seiji come together but not before Guri decides that she likes Seiji as well. What seems awesome to most guys becomes hell for Seiji who just wants a normal relationship with girls.

Una nota di bacio è un notebook potente che rende chiunque abbia il loro nome scritto insieme si innamora immediatamente se si baciano a prescindere da qualsiasi circostanza. Questo oggetto magico e molto familiare appartiene ad un angelo di nome Guri il cui compito come cupido è quello di creare coppie. Tuttavia, per sbaglio, scrive Aino Seiji, una normale studentessa del liceo, e a meno che non baci qualcuno, Guri morirà. Convince Seiji ad andare a baciare la sua cotta, Hiyama Akane, la ragazza popolare della scuola che si scopre avere sentimenti ancora più forti per lui, confinando con ossessivi e psicotici. Alla fine Akane e Seiji si riuniscono, ma non prima che Guri decida che le piace anche Seiji. Quello che sembra fantastico per la maggior parte dei ragazzi diventa un inferno per Seiji che vuole solo una relazione normale con le ragazze.
21645: The anime follows the Marginal#4 idol unit, who made their debut at Pythagoras Production on February 13. The members give their all for their fans in their idol activities, but they are also normal high school students. The anime will follow both their everyday lives as high school students and their lives as idols.
21709: Yuri Katsuki makes his way to the Grand Prix ice skating competition as Japan’s top representative with his eyes on the prize. However, instead of celebrating, Yuri walks away defeated and ready to retire for good. But a run-in with champion Viktor Nikiforov and rising star Yuri Plisetsky ignites a new fire within him. With the two of them close by his side, Yuri will take to the ice once more.

Yuri Katsuki si dirige verso il Gran Premio di pattinaggio sul ghiaccio, mentre il Giappone è il primo rappresentante con gli occhi sul premio. Tuttavia, invece di festeggiare, Yuri se ne va sconfitto e pronto a ritirarsi per sempre. Ma un incontro con il campione Viktor Nikiforov e la stella nascente Yuri Plisetsky accende un nuovo fuoco dentro di lui. Con i due vicini al suo fianco, Yuri tornerà al ghiaccio.
21773: Six years ago Momo taught Nino the joy of singing from her heart. When Momo’s family moved away without warning, Nino found herself lost and adrift. Until she met Yuzu, who also had a musical gift that he shared with her until he was suddenly gone as well, leaving nothing but the memory of his music. Before they disappeared, both Momo and Yuzu said the same thing- that Nino should keep singing, because that was how they’d find her again. Now, as Nino starts high school, their paths are all about to cross again. But while Nino has kept singing and remembering how things were, Momo and Yuzu have changed.

Sei anni fa Momo insegnò a Nino la gioia di cantare dal suo cuore. Quando la famiglia Momo è andata via senza preavviso, Nino si è ritrovata persa e alla deriva. Fino a quando non incontrò Yuzu, che aveva anche un dono musicale che lui condivideva con lei fino a quando non se ne andò, lasciando solo il ricordo della sua musica. Prima che scomparissero, Momo e Yuzu hanno detto la stessa cosa, che Nino dovrebbe continuare a cantare, perché è così che l'hanno ritrovata. Ora, quando Nino inizia il liceo, le loro strade stanno per incrociarsi di nuovo. Ma mentre Nino continuava a cantare e a ricordare come stavano le cose, Momo e Yuzu sono cambiati.
21837: Baramon High School, a private boys' school for the prefecture's most elite. The protagonist transferred into the school and meets various major players on campus, such as the "outlaw teacher," the soccer captain, and a childhood friend whom the protagonist has not seen in seven years. The school presents opportunities for friendship, love, and conflict. The tagline of the game is, "Whenever you exited the school gates, you were handsome."

Il liceo Baramon, una scuola privata per ragazzi della prefettura. Il protagonista si trasferì nella scuola e incontrò vari protagonisti del campus, come il "maestro fuorilegge," il capitano del calcio, e un amico d'infanzia che il protagonista non vedeva da sette anni. La scuola offre opportunità di amicizia, amore e conflitto. L'etichetta del gioco è: "Quando sei uscito dai cancelli della scuola, eri bello."
87501: Bundled with the limited edition of 14th Baki-Dou manga volume.
Bundled con l'edizione limitata del 14 ° volume manga Baki-Dou.
97933:
"Wake Up, Girls!" is the story of growth and friendship of seven girls living in Sendai, Miyagi who form the idol group "Wake Up, Girls! (WUG)" and work together to become top idols.

Operating under a small production company in Sendai known as "Green Leaves Entertainment," WUG overcame countless obstacles to beat national idol group "I-1 club" at the Idol Festival and win the event. They had suddenly become top idols... but with an idol recession going on, things weren't so easy. The days of steady and honest idol work continued for the girls.

Meanwhile, Sendai-based middle school trio Hayashi Ayumi, Morishima Otome, and Atsugi Itsuka have developed an increasing desire to become idols...
98573: The story is set in Japan in 2020. The story centers on Shin Hazama, and a version of himself who led a different life in another Japan appears. A crack opens in the everyday life that he thought was impossible to change. Boys and girls have to decide what to think and choose when the world changes completely. The battle with another world and another self begins.
99085: Nobita and his friends find a strange frozen ring, which guides them to Antarctica in search of its owner. There, they stumble upon some ancient ruins and begin an adventure, facing the danger that the Earth may become frozen.
99213: An absurd film by Kuri Yoji.
99725: In Japan in the year 2035, an accident known as the "Burst" occurs during a research project, spawning an out-of-control artificial life form called "Matter" that has spread throughout the Kurobe Gorge. The research city that was once hailed as the hope for humanity is cordoned off by the government. Two years later, 15-year-old Aiko Tachibana, who lost her family in the Burst, learns something unbelievable from Yuya Kanzaki, a new student at her school. A secret is hidden within her body, and the answer to the puzzle lies at the "Primary Point" that was the center of the Burst. When boy meets girl with the fate of humanity in their hands, what new truth will come to light?

In Giappone, nel 2035, un incidente noto come "Burst" si verifica durante un progetto di ricerca, generando una forma di vita artificiale fuori controllo chiamata "Matter" che si è diffusa in tutta la gola di Kurobe. La città di ricerca che un tempo era stata salutata come la speranza per l'umanità è circondata dal governo. Due anni dopo, Aiko Tachibana, quindicenne, che ha perso la sua famiglia nel Burst, impara qualcosa di incredibile da Yuya Kanzaki, una nuova studentessa della sua scuola. Un segreto è nascosto nel suo corpo, e la risposta al puzzle si trova al "Punto Primario" che era il centro della Borsa. Quando il ragazzo incontra la ragazza con il destino dell'umanità nelle loro mani, quale nuova verità verrà alla luce?
100749: One day, Kun’s mother brings home a new family member. For the four-year-old boy, joy quickly turns to disappointment when the little sister replaces her brother as the center of attention.  The boy can’t bring himself to accept her as his sister.  But things turn magical when, with a mysterious garden as his gateway, the boy encounters his mother as a little girl and his great-grandfather as a young man, and has a series of surprising adventures with his older sister from the future. These experiences change how he sees the world and help him grow into the big brother he was meant to be.

Un giorno, la madre di Kun è tornata a casa con un nuovo membro della famiglia. Per il bambino di quattro anni, la gioia si trasforma rapidamente in delusione quando la sorellina sostituisce suo fratello come centro di attenzione. Il ragazzo può portare se stesso ad accettarla come sua sorella. Ma le cose diventano magiche quando, con un giardino misterioso come porta d'accesso, il ragazzo incontra sua madre da bambina e il suo bisnonno da giovane, e ha una serie di avventure sorprendenti con la sorella maggiore dal futuro. Queste esperienze cambiano il modo in cui vede il mondo e lo aiutano a crescere nel fratello maggiore che doveva essere.
100813: The second season of Spiritpact (Ling Qi). The series' Japanese dub premiered simultaneously with the original Chinese version and aired on Tokyo MX.
La seconda stagione di Spiritpact (Ling Qi). Il dub giapponese della serie è stato presentato contemporaneamente alla versione originale cinese e trasmesso su Tokyo MX.
101261:
The stage is Asakusa. One day, three 2nd-year middle school students — Kazuki Yasaka, Tooi Kuji, and Enta Jinnai — meet a mysterious kappa-like creature named Keppi, who forcibly takes their shirikodama (a mythical organ kappa steal through a person's anus) and transforms the boys into kappa.

Keppi informs them, "If you wish to return to your former selves, you must connect in 'that way' and bring me the shirikodama of zombies." Will the three boys be able to connect as they steal shirikodama from zombies?! Meanwhile, two policemen — Reo Niiboshi and Mabu Akutsu — are up to something at the police box where they are stationed.

Il palco è Asakusa. Un giorno, tre studenti delle scuole medie del secondo anno Kazuki Yasaka, Tooi Kuji ed Enta Jinnai incontrano una misteriosa creatura simile al kappa di nome Keppi, che prende con la forza il loro shirikodama (un mitico kappa d'organo rubato attraverso l'ano di una persona) e trasforma i ragazzi in kappa.

Keppi li informa: "Se volete tornare al vostro ex io, dovete connettervi in 'così' e portarmi lo shirikodama degli zombie." I tre ragazzi saranno in grado di connettersi mentre rubano shirikodama agli zombie?! Nel frattempo, due poliziotti Reo Niiboshi e Mabu Akutsu stanno tramando qualcosa nella cabina della polizia dove sono di stanza.
101581: Unaired episodes bundled with the 11th, 12th, 13th, and 24th volumes of the Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san manga.
Episodi di unaired in bundle con l'11th, 12th, 13th, e 24th volumi dello Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san manga.

E' anche a capo del club di scienze della scuola e si innamora segretamente di uno dei suoi membri, uno studente di seconda elementare Tanaka. Episodio aggiuntivo di Sword Art Offline incluso nella Sword Art Online: Scala Ordinale Blu-ray e DVD
102093:
First of three compilation films of the Kuroko no Basket franchise.

The first match of Seirin vs Touou Gakuen at the Winter Cup. Seirin swore they would get revenge from the Inter-High, but Aomine's talents grew even stronger and Kuroko's new move is seen through. After having all of his efforts denied by his former light, Aomine, Kuroko is benched and faces humiliation. Seeing his partner like this, something almost beast-like awakens within Kagami, and he challenges Aomine. Aomine had lost almost all sense of fighting, until he and Kagami both intensely face off with each other as they go into the Zone.

Primo dei tre film compilativi del franchise Kuroko no Basket.

La prima partita di Seirin vs Touou Gakuen alla Winter Cup. Seirin ha giurato che avrebbero ottenuto vendetta dall'Inter-High, ma i talenti di Aomine sono diventati ancora più forti e la nuova mossa di Kuroko è stata vista attraverso. Dopo aver avuto tutti i suoi sforzi negati dalla sua vecchia luce, Aomine, Kuroko è panchinato e affronta l'umiliazione. Vedendo il suo partner così, qualcosa di quasi bestiale si risveglia dentro Kagami, e sfida Aomine. Aomine aveva perso quasi ogni senso di lotta, fino a quando lui e Kagami non si affrontano intensamente l'uno con l'altro mentre vanno nella Zona.
102157: A woman’s face disappearing behind, and emerging from, a pair of hands. Flashing lights. An empty building full of dark hallways. Designs drawn in the air with light and long-exposure cinematography.
102349:
It is the beginning of December. Anna Kushina’s birthday is coming up, so the boys of HOMRA decide to celebrate by preparing a surprise party for their little princess. Tatara Totsuka, the only clansman capable of keeping the destructive power of the Red King, Mikoto Souh, in check wants to do something special and film a video for Anna's birthday.

Meanwhile, the new Colorless King sets his plan to devour the other kings in motion...

È l'inizio di dicembre. Il compleanno di Anna Kushina è in arrivo, quindi i ragazzi di HOMRA decidono di festeggiare preparando una festa a sorpresa per la loro piccola principessa. Tatara Totsuka, l'unico clan in grado di mantenere il potere distruttivo del Re Rosso, Mikoto Souh, sotto controllo vuole fare qualcosa di speciale e filmare un video per il compleanno di Anna.

Nel frattempo, il nuovo Re Senza Colori stabilisce il suo piano per divorare gli altri re in movimento...
102925:
This story is about Mick, a sleeping chironomid. Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. An epic space adventure of Mick and his friends of their journey back home to Earth.

The development plans and experiments are aborted by humans for no known reason, the organisms are left behind in the space station with limited resources. Going over hurdles and fighting through challenges, together, they travel across planets and gain new comrades, heading for Earth. As their journey progresses, the mystery behind the human’s abandonment unravels…
103181: The story centers on Souji, who is kind but extremely timid. Souji, whose nickname is Mop, starts his first job at the neighborhood yakiniku shop "Sengoku." He struggles and grows together will his unique coworkers at the shop.
103373: An anthology work produced by the Japan Animation Association for their Into Animation 7 festival held at The National Art Center, Tokyo.
103437: Short animations by Shunsuke Saito made for Japanese MTV channel.
103693: The original six-minute "pilot" featured a slightly different version of Might Orbots called Broots (pronounced "Brutes").
