103757:
During the ancient Western Han dynasty (206BC-9AD), a series of disasters caused by occult phenomena swept across the entire world. Huainanzi, the mysterious Chinese book bound in bamboo, was ripped apart and sent through time to different historical junctures. The book pieces were transformed into various objects, waiting to be rediscovered.

A hundred years later, a young man, named Hong Lie, lifts up the burden to collect the missing pieces of the ancient bamboo book. With the help of Ba Gong and his friends going through the Gate of 24 Solar Terms, Hong Lie travels through dynasties to search for the lost pieces.

In his adventure, Hong Lie and his loyal friends, Ji Ming and Gou Tiao, experienced the greatness of the ancient legends, appreciating the wisdom of the ancestors from Chun Qiu Period, and witnessed all the weird things happening among ordinary people. Warmth and coldness, sadness and happiness, separation and reunion, stories led him to the great world in the book Huainanzi. Through exciting adventures, he also made lifelong friends. In this special way, Hong Lie communicated with ancestors and started to see the principle of world, realizing that obeying the laws of nature and being in harmony with the environment was the right thing to do. A simple collecting journey slowly became a challenging trip for him to go on with his family mission, and inherit the ancestor’s spirit.
104077: The new series will center on a team made up of successive generations of Inazuma Eleven characters. The "Inazuma Japan" boys representative team will face teams from around the world.

La nuova serie si concentrerà su un team composto da generazioni successive di Inazuma Eleven personaggi. Il team di rappresentanti ragazzi "Inazuma Japan" affronterà squadre provenienti da tutto il mondo.
104461: The Outdoor Activities Club, Aka, the Outclub has 3 members. In the countryside of Yamanashi Prefecture, there’s a high school named Motosu High School. Go even further to one of the school buildings and you’ll find a very laid-back outdoor club that uses one corner of the classroom as their club room. Kagamihara Nadeshiko finally wants to kill some time in their club room, but then Ohgaki Chiaki and Inuyama Aoi suddenly announce that they’re all going on a trip. The girls enjoy the various local treats as they travel around, but where in the world is the end destination for this trip?!

L'Outdoor Activities Club, Aka, l'Outclub ha 3 membri. Nelle campagne della prefettura di Yamanashi, ci si trova una scuola superiore di nome Motosu High School. Andate ancora più lontano in uno degli edifici scolastici e troverete un club all'aperto molto rilassato che utilizza un angolo dell'aula come loro sala club. Kagamihara Nadeshiko finalmente vuole uccidere un po 'di tempo nella loro sala club, ma poi Ohgaki Chiaki e Inuyama Aoi improvvisamente annunciano che tutti vanno in viaggio. Le bambine si godono le varie prelibatezze locali mentre viaggiano, ma dove nel mondo è la destinazione finale per questo viaggio?!
106509:
OVA 1:

In the midst of his everyday life, Rimuru suddenly realizes that there's nothing to do for recreation in Tempest. He suggests sumo wrestling as a way for everyone to have fun together, and his friends are immediately on board with the idea. Thus begins Tempest's first sumo tournament, in which everyone competes enthusiastically in hopes of winning the grand prize! Passionate contests break out not only among Benimaru and the men, but also among women like Shuna and Shion, and even Rimuru ends up joining in!

OVA 2:

One day, Shuna and Shion are fighting over Rimuru's squishy slime body as usual. Rimuru figures that giving them each a body double of himself would solve the conflict, but when he imagines some of his other friends asking him to do the same for them, he quickly drops that plan. Then he comes up with the idea to make a cushion in the shape of his slime form. He travels around Tempest to see if his friends know of any good materials he can use, and he learns that a special type of sand found along a lakeshore in the forest is exactly what he's looking for. So he sets out to collect some sand... but a monster is waiting for him by the lake! What's more, Milim hears about his plan for a picnic and comes racing down from the sky!

OVA 3-5:

Rimuru, now a teacher at the Freedom Academy in the Kingdom of Ingrassia, has become involved in the school's outdoor training event with his class. The outdoor training event is an annual competition in which the students of each class guard the teachers on a journey to a nearby town. Rimuru is assigned to Class A, while his own students in Class S escort the young Tiss-sensei. All the students are eager to show how much their daily training has paid off, but the situation turns around when they're attacked by thieves!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Bundled with the limited edition of the 12th-16th manga volumes.

OVA 1:

Nel bel mezzo della sua vita quotidiana, Rimuru improvvisamente si rende conto che non c'è nulla da fare per la ricreazione a Tempest. Suggerisce il sumo wrestling come modo per tutti di divertirsi insieme, e i suoi amici sono immediatamente a bordo con l'idea. Inizia così il primo torneo di sumo di Tempest, in cui tutti si sfidano con entusiasmo nella speranza di vincere il grande premio! Non solo tra Benimaru e gli uomini, ma anche tra donne come Shuna e Shion, e anche Rimuru finisce per unirsi!

OVA 2:

Un giorno, Shuna e Shion stanno litigando per il corpo di Rimuru come al solito. Rimuru pensa che donando a ciascuno un corpo doppio di se stesso risolverebbe il conflitto, ma quando immagina alcuni dei suoi altri amici chiedendogli di fare lo stesso per loro, egli cede rapidamente quel piano. Poi si inventa l'idea di fare un cuscino a forma di melma. Viaggia in giro per Tempest per vedere se i suoi amici sanno di qualsiasi buon materiale che può utilizzare, e impara che un tipo speciale di sabbia trovato lungo una riva del lago nella foresta è esattamente quello che sta cercando. Quindi vuole raccogliere della sabbia... ma un mostro lo sta aspettando vicino al lago! Inoltre, Milim sente parlare del suo piano per un picnic e viene a correre giù dal cielo!

OVA 3-5:

Rimuru, ora insegnante alla Freedom Academy nel Regno di Ingrassia, è stato coinvolto nell'evento di formazione all'aperto della scuola con la sua classe. L'evento di formazione all'aperto è un concorso annuale in cui gli studenti di ogni classe sorvegliano gli insegnanti in un viaggio verso una città vicina. Rimuru è assegnato alla classe A, mentre i suoi studenti in classe S scortano il giovane Tiss-sensei. Tutti gli studenti sono ansiosi di mostrare quanto il loro allenamento quotidiano ha pagato, ma la situazione si gira quando vengono attaccati dai ladri!

(Fonte: Crunchyroll)

Nota: Bundled con l'edizione limitata dei 12-16 volumi di manga.
106701:
A girl who loves to dance but has no talent. "Talent" is not something to be added on, but rather "complements what is lacking." The important thing is to continually keep the easily wilted "flower" blooming beautifully.

1st Year Work 2011 by Toyomi Morishita, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.
106893:
The story is set in San Teresa City on the fictional Pacific island of Kariaena. The "buddy police action" series follows the detective Kei Matoba and the alternate-world knight Tirana.

15 years ago, an unknown hyperspace gate opened over the Pacific. Beyond this gate lies Reto Semaani, a strange alternate world where fairies and demons live.

San Teresa City — a city where over two million immigrants live from both worlds. As a result, there are the haves and the have-nots. Here is the world's newest "city of dreams." But in the shadow of the chaos, crime is rampant: drugs, prostitution, and weapon trafficking. The detectives who stand up to these heinous crimes are in the San Teresa City Police. When the detective Kei Matoba and the alternate-world knight Tirana — two individuals who differ in gender, personality, and even world of origin — meet, an incident erupts. Two worlds. Two justices. From this, the curtain rises on a buddy police action story!

La storia è ambientata a San Teresa City sulla fittizia isola del Pacifico di Kariaena. La serie "Action Police" segue il detective Kei Matoba e il cavaliere alternato Tirana.

15 anni fa, un cancello iperspaziale sconosciuto si è aperto sul Pacifico. Al di là di questa porta si trova Reto Semaani, uno strano mondo alternativo dove vivono fate e demoni.

Città di San Teresa è una città dove vivono più di due milioni di immigrati provenienti da entrambi i mondi. Di conseguenza, ci sono i have e i have-not. Ecco la nuova "città dei sogni" del mondo. Ma all'ombra del caos, il crimine è dilagante: droga, prostituzione e traffico d'armi. I detective che si oppongono a questi orribili crimini sono nella polizia di San Teresa. Quando il detective Kei Matoba e il cavaliere alterna-mondo Tirana due individui che differiscono in genere, personalità, e anche mondo di origine si incontrano, un incidente erutta. Due mondi. Due giudici. Da qui, il sipario si alza su un amico poliziotto storia d'azione!
107341:
An animated biographical film about the life of Takae Tsuneo, who was dealt a heavy blow when he lost both of his arms but worked to help other people with disabilities.

At the age of seventeen, Tsuneo is electrocuted during his job installing power lines and has both of his arms amputated. However, he decides to devote his life to poetry and literature, and begins to practice writing by holding a pen with his mouth. He eventually gets a job as a newspaper reporter, and turns his attention to other people dealing with disabilities.

(Source: Japanese Film Database)

Note: Trailer (requires flash): https://jfdb.jp/player/trailer/1207
107917:
When Konoe Moyako and her little brother, Akira, were young, he said he wanted to marry her. Naturally, Moyako decided that her little brother was a complete pervert who was obsessed with her. Now that they're both teenagers, Moyako is convinced she needs to 'rehabilitate' him. However, it seems that the 'perversion' is entirely in her imagination, and she can't seem to help turning completely innocent situations into creepy ones in her mind!

Short flash episodes included on the Ane Log Fan Disc.
108301: The ad Soba e centers on a boy named Osamu who receives an umbrella as a gift from Sayu, but it goes missing. That umbrella transforms into a girl who goes gallivanting around town on a rainy day.
108941: The horse girls are back to charm you in this special, bite-size anime. Umayon comes alive as a cute and eye-catching anime! At a school-turned-training facility, the girls will race, perform, and train... but that's not all! Saddle up for a short-form anime that displays the laidback school days of the horse girls! Aaaaand, they're off!

Le ragazze dei cavalli sono tornate ad affascinarti in questo anime speciale e bocconcino. Umayon si anima come un simpatico e accattivante anime! In un centro di addestramento a scuola, le ragazze gareggeranno, si esibiranno e si alleneranno... ma non è tutto! Sellatevi per un anime a forma corta che vi mostri i giorni di scuola rilassati delle ragazze dei cavalli! Aaaa, sono partiti!
109261:
Through their tutor Fuutarou Uesugi's diligent guidance, the Nakano quintuplets' academic performance shows signs of improvement, even if their path to graduation is still rocky. However, as they continue to cause various situations that delay any actual tutoring, Fuutarou becomes increasingly involved with their personal lives, further complicating their relationship with each other.

On another note, Fuutarou slowly begins to realize the existence of a possible connection between him and the past he believes to have shared with one of the five girls. With everyone's feelings beginning to develop and overlap, will they be able to keep their bond strictly to that of a teacher and his students—or will it mature into something else entirely?

Attraverso la guida diligente del loro tutor Fuutarou Uesugi, la performance accademica dei quintupletti Nakano mostra segni di miglioramento, anche se il loro percorso verso la laurea è ancora roccioso. Tuttavia, mentre continuano a causare varie situazioni che ritardano qualsiasi tutoraggio effettivo, Fuutarou diventa sempre più coinvolto nella loro vita personale, complicando ulteriormente il loro rapporto con l'altro.

Su un'altra nota, Fuutarou comincia lentamente a realizzare l'esistenza di un possibile legame tra lui e il passato che crede di aver condiviso con una delle cinque ragazze. Con i sentimenti di tutti che iniziano a svilupparsi e si sovrappongono, saranno in grado di mantenere il loro legame strettamente con quello di un insegnante e dei suoi studenti o maturerà in qualcos'altro completamente?
110349: Self-styled “Japan's greatest swindler” Makoto Edamura is mainly targeting elder people and occasional foreign travelers. But when he tries to scam an apparently clueless French tourist in Tokyo, he can't possibly imagine that what looked like just another ordinary job is going to take him all the way to Los Angeles, tied upside-down on the famous Hollywood sign… And he is yet to find out what fate awaits him!

Self-styled Il più grande truffatore del Giappone Makoto Edamura sta mirando principalmente persone anziane e viaggiatori occasionali stranieri. Ma quando cerca di truffare un turista francese apparentemente ingenuo a Tokyo, non può immaginare che quello che sembrava un altro lavoro normale lo porterà fino a Los Angeles, legato a testa in giù sul famoso cartello di Hollywood... E deve ancora scoprire che destino lo aspetta!
110413: The story centers on Lupin teaming up with a woman named Leticia to steal the Bresson Diary, a treasure that even the first generation Arsène Lupin could not steal.
La storia si concentra su Lupin che si unisce a una donna di nome Leticia per rubare il Diario di Bresson, un tesoro che nemmeno la prima generazione Arsène Lupin poteva rubare.
110733: From throughout the ages, a group of legendary girls have become zombie idols to save Saga Prefecture. It's the return of the cutting-edge zombie idol anime! One day, Minamoto Sakura lost her life in an unfortunate accident. Then, ten years later… After Sakura wakes up in a strange mansion, mysterious idol producer Tatsumi Kotaro tells her that she will be joining a group of legendary girls to form an idol unit. The seven girls are charged with a quest to save the fading Saga Prefecture and adopt the group name Franchouchou. After overcoming the difficulties stemming from their different ages and different periods of history, their undead zombie bodies allow them to defy expectations of what idols can be. During the final winter of the Heisei era they performed their first featured concert at Karatsu's Furusato Exhibition Hall, Arpino, taking another step towards becoming a legend. Now, in the modern Reiwa Era… The curtain rises on a new chapter in the story of Franchouchou, as they march towards a bright future full of hope.

Da tutte le età, un gruppo di ragazze leggendarie sono diventate idoli zombie per salvare la Prefettura di Saga. E' il ritorno dell'anime zombie all'avanguardia! Un giorno, Minamoto Sakura perse la vita in uno sfortunato incidente. Poi, dieci anni dopo... Dopo che Sakura si sveglia in una strana villa, il misterioso produttore di idoli Tatsumi Kotaro le dice che si unirà a un gruppo di ragazze leggendarie per formare un'unità idolatrica. Le sette ragazze sono incaricate di salvare la prefettura di Saga e adottare il nome del gruppo Franchouchou. Dopo aver superato le difficoltà derivanti dalle loro diverse età e periodi diversi di storia, i loro corpi zombie non morti permettono loro di sfidare le aspettative di ciò che gli idoli possono essere. Durante l'ultimo inverno dell'era degli Heisei hanno eseguito il loro primo concerto al Salone di Furusato di Karatsu, Arpino, facendo un altro passo verso la leggenda. Ora, nell'era moderna di Reiwa... Il sipario sorge su un nuovo capitolo della storia di Franchouchou, mentre marciano verso un futuro luminoso e pieno di speranza.
111501: Chiyuki Fujito has a dream: to become a Paris Collection model. The problem is, she's too short to be a model, and everyone around her tells her so! But no matter what they say, she won't give up. Her classmate, a poor student named Ikuto Tsumura, also has a dream: to become a fashion designer. One day Chiyuki tells him that it's "probably impossible" for him, causing him to consider giving it up...?! This is the story of two individuals wholeheartedly chasing after their dreams in spite of all the negativity that comes after them!

Chiyuki Fujito ha un sogno: diventare un modello Paris Collection. Il problema e' che e' troppo bassa per essere una modella, e tutti quelli che la circondano glielo dicono! Ma qualunque cosa dicano, lei non si arrendera'. Anche il suo compagno di classe, un povero studente di nome Ikuto Tsumura, ha un sogno: diventare un fashion designer. Un giorno Chiyuki gli dice che è "probabilmente impossibile" per lui, facendogli pensare di rinunciare...?! Questa è la storia di due individui che inseguono di tutto cuore i loro sogni nonostante tutta la negatività che li segue!
111949:

114317: Lang Wu Yao is a boy born with a supernatural singing voice. Secluded in the snowy mountains, he is put through severe training by his blind mother. Her wish is for her son's voice to be unrivaled, so that it will be heard by the imperial court. But the intense training results in a tragic accident, where she dies. Left an orphan as a result, Lang wanders the land. His voice is used as a tool by the wicked and greedy, with his heart being ground down in the process. Eventually his strange singing catches the ear of the princess of Xi You, and Lang is elevated to the stage his mother had dreamt of. But what awaits him is a life or death battle performance against other musicians for the amusement of the members of the court. Until one day, Lang learns of the rumors of the Sword Plundering Nemesis, an infamous bandit known through all of Xi You for stealing magical weapons. What he doesn't know is that the  next weapon in the sights of this thief has been hidden by the emperor in the same castle Lang has been performing in.

Quando i Pilastri appaiono improvvisamente sulla Terra, minacciando tutta la vita, è solo l'atto del dio Odino che offre la salvezza dell'umanità. Fornendo un mezzo per reagire, dà alla Terra le Valchirie, giovani piloti femminili con poteri soprannaturali e aerei da caccia spirituali. Questi abili troublemakers, tutti giovani, rischiano la loro vita in una guerra lunga ma la battaglia finale si sta avvicinando!

(Fonte: Funimazione)

Nota: Il primo episodio è stato trasmesso con un runtime di ~48 minuti.

128397: A mini-animation depicting the daily life of the Seiin High School Men's Volleyball Club posted on the 2.43 Twitter account.
129037: Twenty years after the war between immortals and demons, the Three Realms have reached a state of delicate balance. It was at this time that the young man Ye Bugui, who was carrying an important secret, broke free from the protection of the Sword Spirit Island and appeared in front of everyone. His appearance broke the balance and the conspiracy that had lain dormant since the end of the war resurfaced. While trying to protect the world, Ye Bugui is aware of his own destiny. His life journey is full of dangers, with people joining and leaving him along the way. The meaning behind his name, "Bu Gui" - "no return", may just be his fate.
129165: An old fisherman catches a fish bowl from the sea, the fishing child painted on the bowl comes out to reality to catch a lot of pearls for him. A missionary wants to occupy the bowl and is punished by the fishing child.
129229: Emperor Ming of the Han Dynasty gave Ban Chao, a member of the Shi Family, the bronze swallow talisman and instructed him to travel to the Western Regions in search of the golden Buddha he had dreamed of as well as the secret to immortality. Ban Chao looked for 36 people, including the masters who were hiding in the capital, the Mo family's descendants, the Pirates' descendants, and the Gu master of Yelang who was traveling with him. Along with granting the emperor's wish, he also sought to learn the history of the Shi family and identify the murderer who had falsely accused his father.
129549: Ranka Lee is on an interplanetary concert tour several years after the battle against the Vajra. The existence of Kappa, water imps, has long been believed in Japan. It was said that they lived in rivers and lakes. In fact, there were people who saw them. You can find Kappa as a subject in paintings, sculptures and stories. In the 20th century, Japan has become a highly industrialized country. Reclaimed lakes, rivers with concreted banks, large quantities of chemicals for the fields. Fish, insects, birds and animals lost their home. So did Kappa. This film depicts the waterside scene in Japan when Kappa lived vividly. We might have a chance to see them if we could prevent the further environmental pollution and make it easier for the other creatures to live.

(Source: Association Internationale du Film d’Animation - Japan Branch)

202253:
“My mom became a crater.”

The Death Stranding—a catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living.

In the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them, a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate.

The story is set in North America immediately after Sam—the protagonist of the game—reconnects the continent by means of the Chiral Network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences.

In this tumultuous new landscape, there are some who walk a different path to the one chosen by Sam and his Bridges comrades: a wise old man who connects people through a method that defies all reckoning; a female soldier ensnared in a cycle of war and destruction; a boy who seethes with rage at the absurdity of his life...and of course, the girl who chose to sever all ties with the outside world...Fate has other plans for her, however, and chance encounters see her launched headfirst into a world she does not recognize.

Ma ogni volta che riapre gli occhi, Lilithea è lì al suo fianco, pronta ad aiutarlo ad arrivare in fondo al mistero...

Graduation work of Man Wei from Musashino Art University.

In ”I Remember” the juxtaposition of art styles was not only used as a narrative device, but also directly and organically as part of the story itself. The characteristics of animation was used to create an indirect metaphor for growth through the changes in painting style.

As the style of the painting changed, a story is told from a childhood dream of becoming a painter, and information is collected from the dream about people, places, and incidents related to these memories. As a result of this process, a childhood was painted in a style of its own incorporating the past and the gradual shift in style as they grow up.
